facts.text: A test case is one fully specified test with an expected result; a test matrix is a table of test cases arranged by the factors they vary; a scenario grid is a matrix whose cells are concrete scenarios.
facts.quote: A test case is one fully specified test with an expected result, a test matrix is a table of test cases arranged by the factors they vary, and a scenario grid is a matrix whose cells are concrete scenarios.

facts.text: ISO 34505:2025 lists test-case attributes as an identifier, an objective, inputs, steps, the test platform (simulator, bench or track), and expected results.

facts.text: An example test case specifies a loader reversing at 9 km/h toward a standing worker 12 m away on a 4% grade, with an expected brake request before 6 m and a stop with at least 1 m of clearance.
facts.quote: "Loader reverses at 9 km/h toward a standing worker 12 m away on a 4% grade; expected: brake request before 6 m and a stop with at least 1 m of clearance" is a test case.

facts.text: The physical anchor campaign planned using a test matrix covers the first six weeks after hardware delivery and measures latency and stops on grades.

facts.text: The Euro NCAP virtual-testing protocol requires the manufacturer to predict results for the full scenario grid, then physically tests randomly selected cells.

facts.text: The Euro NCAP virtual-testing protocol accepts virtual results if at least 75% of the verification tests in each cluster meet the criteria.
facts.quote: accepts the virtual results if at least 75% of the verification tests in each cluster meet the criteria [Chapter 3].

facts.text: The Euro NCAP virtual-testing protocol is an on-road consumer protocol, and no off-road body has adopted an equivalent.

facts.text: The booklet warns against treating the entire validation program as one giant test matrix because every combination of site, scenario, weather, model and sensor cannot be run; test-selection methods must instead populate the matrix.

facts.text: Test cases carry traceability from hazard to evidence in the collision mitigation validation program.
